name: BakePrice Studio
headline: Price the whole bake. Quote with a clear cost picture.
summary: An offline recipe-costing and quote tool for home bakers. Include whole batches, ingredient costs, labour and packaging before choosing your selling price.
audience: Home bakers and small custom-order bakeries who want to cost one recipe and prepare a customer quote.
needs: A laptop or desktop with a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari browser. Unzip the files and open START.html. No account, spreadsheet app or internet connection is required for the tool. Save JSON backups; browser storage may be cleared or unavailable.
includes: Offline recipe costing and customer quote tool
Whole-batch costing, labour, fees and chosen-margin calculations
Printable quote with deposit and balance calculation
Editable order log and 10 practical AI prompts
PDF field guide and editable Markdown instructions
limits: Manual planning tool for one recipe per project. Ingredient pack and usage quantities must use the same unit. No tax calculation, nutrition/allergen analysis, stock system, invoicing compliance or automatic store sync. Quotes use your chosen inputs and require your review; no earnings are promised.
sample: An order needs 14 cupcakes but the recipe makes 12. Two whole batches make 24. If each batch costs INR 240 in ingredients, this order consumes INR 480 in ingredients before labour, packaging, fees or overhead. Unless the remaining 10 are separately allocated, charging only for 14/12 of a batch understates the cash required for this bake.
first_run: Open START.html and load the Cupcake batch example.
Change the order from 12 to 14 and watch the whole-batch count change.
Enter your own recipe and costs, then export a JSON backup.
Choose your actual quote price and print the reviewed customer quote.
outcomes: Compare current quote price with a cost-based scenario
See spare units created by whole-batch production
Prepare a quote without exposing internal cost details
google_descriptions: Cost ingredients, labour and whole batches. Prepare a quote with your own numbers.
Offline browser tool, PDF guide and worked examples. One-time purchase: INR 699.
See batch quantities and spare units before choosing your quote. No account needed.
For home bakers. Download, unzip and open on your computer. No automatic store sync.

name: Salon Content Sprint
headline: Plan the month. Film with a clear brief.
summary: Thirty salon content slots with English and Roman-script Hinglish captions, twelve reel plans, eight carousel scripts and an offline editing planner.
audience: Salon owners and freelance social media managers planning content for a local salon.
needs: A laptop or desktop browser for the offline planner, your own salon facts and rights-cleared photos or footage. No AI subscription is required to use the supplied copy. Filming, design, posting and client approval are your responsibility. Back up your edits as JSON.
includes: 30 editable content slots and 60 captions: English + Roman-script Hinglish
12 reel filming plans and 8 five-slide carousel scripts
30 story ideas and an owner fact sheet
Offline planner with draft editing, JSON backups and CSV export
20 staged AI prompts and client approval worksheets
PDF field guide and editable Markdown content bank
limits: Planning files and copy, not finished image or video assets, a Canva template library, account automation or a scheduling service. Replace bracketed fields and review every claim and permission before posting. No booking, follower or revenue results are guaranteed. Hinglish is Roman-script Hindi-English and needs audience review.
sample: Hook: Bring the photo. Bring your questions too. Caption: A reference photo helps explain a direction. Your hair, routine and appointment plan may call for a different finish. Save two references and tell your stylist what you like in each. Add the salon's confirmed booking instruction. Film: an original moodboard, a written preference and an empty mirror. No customer footage is needed.
